title: Slice the test coverage any way you need
statement: As a developer, I can slice our tests by feature, story, persona, kind and more, and run that slice, so I can answer the question in front of me without building a report.
overview: Trevor's direction: there is a suite of QA tools here for slicing this information. Everything it reads already exists, and this story adds a way to ask.

acceptance_criteria.statement: `query e2e-catalog` filters by feature, story, criterion, persona, kind, code path, and whether a test is stale.
Filters combine, so "negative tests for the checkout feature" is one command.
The same filters work over every test case, with end-to-end as one more filter.
The QA section offers the same filters and keeps them in its URL.
Any slice of end-to-end tests can be printed in the formats that run them.
